我已经二十多年没有重回旧地，说不定已经改变了不少，\n希望高将军的府邸依然还在原:
I haven't returned to my old place for over twenty years; maybe I've changed quite a bit,
he hoped General Gao's residence would still be in its original location.
我已经说服知府大人先撤销了黄义的通缉令，\n只要堂审结果出来，开封府就会马上回复:
I have already persuaded the prefect to withdraw Huang Yi's wanted notice first,
as soon as the trial results are out, Kaifeng Prefecture will immediately restore his innocence,
At this moment, he no longer had to live a hidden, evasive life,
我并非不愿相信杨师兄之言，\n不过缘分云云，未免有些…:
It's not that I don't want to believe Brother Yang's words,
but fate and all that are a bit much...
我幼时听兄长讲兵书史籍，也知道秦陷大梁这一战，\n没想到大梁城在一瞬间消失的真相:
When I was young, I listened to my elder brother lecture on military and historical texts, and I also knew that the battle where Qin captured Daliang,
he never expected that the truth behind Daliang City's sudden disappearance would be like this,
if you hadn't witnessed this astonishing sight here with your own eyes, it would have been hard to believe...
我很久没回开封了，下次回去祭拜先父的时候，\n我会在坟前告诉他这件事，他的确曾经:
I haven't returned to Kaifeng for a long time. Next time I go back to pay respects to my late father,
I will tell him about this at the grave; he did indeed once hold the Dragon Emperor in his hands,
so in the afterlife... Then there should be no more regrets.
我很少喝酒，更不曾如此与人一起共饮，\n但面对着你…这种不习惯的事却觉得如此自然:
I rarely drink, and I have never shared this with others like this,
but when facing you... This kind of unfamiliar thing feels so natural,
我很高兴你明白了那段话的含意，证明你兼具智慧与力量，\n不过你要有所觉悟，魔枪一:
I'm glad you understand the meaning of those words, proving that you possess both wisdom and strength,
but you need to be prepared: once the demon spear starts swinging, it won't show mercy.
我怎么敢看不起申大哥…既然你这么说，\n那我只好不客气的收下了，多谢你送我这么贵:
How could I dare look down on Brother Shen... Since you say so,
so I had no choice but to accept it without hesitation. Thank you for giving me such a valuable gift.
我想这样是最好的。虽然已经过了几年时间，\n但我相信方大娘必定会一眼就认出她日夜:
I think this is the best way. Although several years have passed,
but I believe Madam Fang will recognize the son she has missed day and night at a glance,
No matter what the outcome is, at least these questions will have an answer.
我想这桩旧案突然有如此转折，或许与申少侠有关，\n于是冒险到开封府旁窥探，正巧听:
I think this sudden turn in this old case might be related to Young Master Shen,
so you risk going to the Kaifeng Prefecture to spy and happen to overhear your conversation with a judge,
Learning that my exoneration of charges truly has a chance, and all of this is thanks to Young Hero Shen,
我想麻烦雁君妹子…帮我继续照顾董兄，\n即使机会渺茫，我还是希望能治好他的瘴毒，:
I want to trouble Yan Jun, my sister... Help me continue to take care of Brother Dong,
even if the chances are slim, I still hope to cure his miasma,
if he just doesn't wake up like this, it would be too pitiful...
我拼死抵抗，虽然没被他得逞，却也被他殴打成伤，\n老爷知道此事后，担心我会心怀不:
I fought desperately. Although he didn't succeed, he beat me until I was wounded,
when the master learned of this, he worried that I might harbor resentment and reveal the Liao situation,
so they locked me here to prevent any leaks. I don't know how many days have passed.
我改以占术寻找，算出你们会在天柱峰的某个方角，\n于是带着点朱一起来这里等你们出:
I switched to divination to find you, calculating that you would be somewhere in Tianzhu Peak,
so I brought Dian Zhu here to wait for you to appear,
although she was skeptical, my divination was indeed correct.
我早已算到你们会来，所以倒也说不上打扰，\n虽然以我对你们的所知，你们与禁军的关:
I already anticipated you would come, so I can't really say I'm disturbing you,
although, from what I know of you, your relationship with the Imperial Guards should be even deeper,
but it was Wen Zuocheng who introduced you through the mediator, which was Ding's miscalculation.
我明白…多谢萧姑娘愿意对我坦诚以告，\n既然如此，在下我也有几句话想说，\n不知:
I understand... Thank you, Miss Xiao, for being willing to be honest with me,
since that's the case, I also have a few words to say,
I wonder if you'd like to listen?
我明白了，小钟离的主人所在之处，\n可能就是我们要找的房间，黑雾乱界的源头就在那:
I understood now, where Little Zhongli's master is,
it might be the room we're looking for, the source of the Black Mist Chaotic Realm is right there,
Yao, Lan, Brother He, let's hurry and follow!
我明白了，这是你的选择，\n那么我现在能做的就是尽朋友之责，\n用一切努力阻止你:
I understand, this is your choice,
so what I can do now is fulfill my duty as a friend,
Doing everything possible to stop you until the very last moment...
我明白萧姑娘的感受，于此我也经常感到不解，\n不过如果我们真有什么渊源，上天又安:
I understand how Miss Xiao feels, and I often feel puzzled by this,
but if we truly have some connection, and Heaven arranged for us to meet,
perhaps one day, we will understand all of this...
我是个土生土长的徐州人，\n从小最喜欢的就是各个英雄豪杰的事迹，\n而咱们这徐州:
I am a native of Xuzhou,
since childhood, my favorite thing has been the stories of various heroes and outstanding figures,
and our Xuzhou once produced a world-famous hero...
我曾想将此信投予开封府，又担心他们不会相信，\n但若由你们转交此信代我申冤，那肯:
I once considered sending this letter to the Kaifeng Prefecture, but I worried they wouldn't believe it,
but if you were to deliver this letter to me to seek justice, it would certainly be completely different,
as long as they read this letter, they should be able to find the real culprit and clear my name.
我有位朋友叫做高任，前阵子来我这里作客，\n他提起之前得一位肩披狼皮、名叫申子隽:
I have a friend named Gao Ren, who recently came to visit me as a guest,
he mentioned that he had previously received the help of a young hero named Shen Zijun, wearing wolf skin on his shoulders,
he said that Young Hero Shen was not only highly skilled, but also warm-hearted, righteous, and helpful,
我来的时候就这样了，或许是敌人在藏宝阁里触动了机关，\n不过由于不知道它通往何处:
This is how it was when I arrived. Perhaps the enemy triggered a mechanism in the Treasure Pavilion,
but since I didn't know where it led, I didn't dare to enter casually,
they could only hold their position here for now, at least to prevent the other side from escaping.
我正想清喉咙叫他拿着那铁锤滚出去之际，\n脑子突然不晓得哪里抽了，竟然接受了这桩:
Just as I was about to clear my throat and tell him to take the hammer and roll out,
suddenly, my mind went blank, and I actually accepted this absurd deal,
我没学过炼药，不清楚炼出来的到底行不行，\n所以还是先带回来让妳看过再说。:
I've never learned alchemy, so I'm not sure if what I make works or not,
so it's better to bring it back first so you can see it first.
我爹一直希望大哥能好好念书考取功名，\n但大哥他对习武更有兴趣，打算就近入神武门:
My father always hoped my eldest brother would study hard and pass the imperial exams,
but the eldest brother was more interested in martial arts and planned to join the Shenwu Sect nearby to learn martial arts,
The two of them often argue fiercely over this, which really annoys me...
我爹说…他看到那对绿色眼睛的瞬间突然清醒，\n于是转身拔腿就跑，脑里还听得到那蛇:
My dad said... The moment he saw those green eyes, he suddenly became alert,
so he turned and ran, still hearing the snake demon's shrill scream behind him,
he said his seven souls had already been absorbed into five souls, and even if he ran away, he would become a cripple.
我爹说本朝重文轻武，好好读书求取功名才是正道，\n不过我还是想要长大后成为大哥哥:
My father said that our dynasty values literature over military affairs; studying hard and seeking fame is the right path,
but I still want to grow up and become a handsome hero like you, big brother!
我猜某些掌灯侍者和执明侍者的身上多半有，\n那些家伙负责照管紫璇宫的各处，肯定会:
I guess some of the lamp-lighting attendants and attendants often carry them,
those guys are responsible for overseeing various parts of Zixuan Palace, so they will definitely need command tokens,
我猜这邪鬼原是被监禁在这处与外界隔绝的山洞中，\n之前的地震使岩壁崩落后，露出了:
I guess this evil spirit was originally imprisoned in this cave isolated from the outside world,
after the previous earthquake caused the rock wall to collapse, the cave entrance leading to this place was exposed,
and also destroyed the stone pillar formation that sealed it,
我的修为本就远不如钱塘龙王，一旦让他蓄力完成，\n即使竭尽镇水珠的所有力量也保护:
My cultivation is already far inferior to the Qiantang Dragon King. Once he charges up and completes it,
even if all the power of the Water Suppression Pearl is exhausted, it still can't protect this place...
我的兄长名叫公输彻，他立志要发扬祖传的机关术，\n但他为了这个理想穷忙了七八年，:
My elder brother is named Gongshu Che. He is determined to carry forward the ancestral secret arts,
but he worked hard for seven or eight years for this ideal,
he didn't get anything out of it,
我的看法与三哥、四哥大同小异，既然此刻不宜强行，\n那么暂且将此事延后，等待时机:
My views are roughly the same as Third Brother and Fourth Brother. Since this is not the time to force it,
so postponing this matter for now and waiting for the right moment is not wrong.
我的老骨头又开始疼了，根据在这里住几十年的经验，\n应该是有个风暴快要来了，而且:
My old bones started hurting again. Based on decades of living here,
there must be a storm about to come, and it's a huge one...
我真是蠢…兰姐姐刚提醒完就误触了机关，\n这道石墙如此坚实厚重，想必也是机关迷阵:
I'm really stupid... Sister Lan had just reminded her when she accidentally triggered the mechanism,
this stone wall is so solid and heavy, it must be part of the maze formation,
it seems I can only find another way here and try to reunite with Yao and the others...
我瞧兰姐姐和瑶妹也以姊妹相称好了，\n看妳们两人这样站在一起，朱紫相映，\n还真:
I see that Sister Lan and Sister Yao should also address each other as sisters,
Seeing you two standing together like this, the red and purple colors complement each other,
they really do look like a pair of beautiful and outstanding sisters.
我知道不能一直这样下去，\n然而脑袋里总是一片昏沉，也想不出该怎么做才好…:
I know I can't go on like this,
but her mind was always a mess, and she couldn't figure out what to do...
我知道他们必是为了继承灵女之血的小红而来，\n只有抢先一步将她带走，才能避免她落:
I knew they must have come to inherit the Spirit Maiden's blood, Xiaohong,
only by taking her away first could they avoid falling into the hands of the Blood Spirit Palace,
我知道你们来此是想问辽人为何袭击玉清昭应宫，\n你们的确是找对了人，不过其中内情:
I know you have come here to ask why the Liao people attacked the Yuqing Zhaoying Palace,
you really did find the right person, but the details involved many confidential matters,
Whatever you hear from me, don't let anything leak out. Do you understand?
我知道你们身手高强，不过如果要招惹那些家伙，\n对你们来说也未必是件易事，总之…:
I know you're highly skilled, but if you want to provoke those guys,
it might not be easy for you either, but in short... You must be very careful,
then I'll be leaving first. I hope you all stay safe and sound.
我知道啊，和我一起来这里玩的阿吉把它拿走了，\n我笑他矮子玩大刀，那把剑立起来比:
I know, Ah-Ji, who came here with me to play, took it away,
I laughed at him for playing with a broadsword, but when he stood upright, his sword was even taller than his height,
you can tell at a glance that he can't use it at all,
我知道妳心里气师父无情的在众人面前宣布将妳逐出门墙，\n只能说那时气氛着实险恶，:
I know you're angry that Master has ruthlessly announced in front of everyone that he will kick you out of the house,
it can only be said that the atmosphere was truly tense back then, and Zhu Yu kept threatening him with words,
as the sect leader, only in this way could he explain himself to everyone present,
我知道早晚有人会找到这里来，\n但不论如何，求你们救救她…:
I know that sooner or later someone will come here,
but no matter what, please save her...
我知道自己成了杀人凶嫌，不能再继续久留，\n但由于担心小红，我还是在附近待了一阵:
I knew I had become a murder suspect and couldn't stay any longer,
but worried about Xiaohong, I stayed nearby for a while to gather information,
only after learning that she had been adopted by the Pei couple did I feel at ease and leave.
我知道，小伙子…不用为这点小事大声嚷嚷，\n你做得不错，毕竟你本就是有资格与我一:
I know, young man... No need to shout loudly over such trivial matters,
you did well, after all, you are the one qualified to peer into the abyss with me,
我虽然觉得不妥，但他把抢到的珍奇药材与宝物全留给我，\n所以我也没说什么，但他后:
Although I felt it was inappropriate, he left all the rare medicinal herbs and treasures he had snatched to me,
so I didn't say much, but later he started bringing back some dying fugitives,
我被申大哥的声音叫醒时，发现那东西就在我面前，\n幸好你们打败了它，它离开后…我:
When I was woken up by Brother Shen's voice, I found that thing right in front of me,
Fortunately, you defeated it, and after it left... I felt my whole body feel light,
and I know... From now on, I won't have to fear this mountain path again.
我要问的问题问完了，多谢你解开了我的疑惑，\n现在轮到我告诉你我所说的秘密，而这:
I've finished asking the questions I wanted to ask. Thank you for clearing up my doubts,
now it's my turn to tell you the secret I mentioned, and it all concerns that man in black,
this all started when my brother Liang Shangxiao came to Xiangyang to see me last time...
我记得那边有道铁栅门，应该是通往城下的水室，\n那是河水高涨时容纳洪水用的，平常:
I remember there was an iron gate over there, which should be the water chamber leading to the city walls,
that was used to hold floodwaters when the river rose, and usually no one paid attention to it,
even I myself have never been inside to see it.
我设法筹到了钱，他说准备好之后就会出发，\n结果隔天我就没在城里看到他了，\n之:
I managed to raise the money, and he said he would set out once it was ready,
but the next day, I didn't see him in the city anymore,
since then, there has been no news at all.
我身上能说得上特别的只有方大娘给的这套衣服，\n而这原本是给她失踪的儿子的…等等:
The only thing I can truly call special is this outfit given by Madam Fang,
and this was originally meant for her missing son... Wait, now let's compare the two,
Senior Brother Wuzhen's age and build are indeed very similar to mine. Could it be...
我这乡野粗人口舌拙劣，举止粗鄙，\n失礼之处还请瑶妹多多包涵。:
I, a rustic country bumpkin, am clumsy in speech and coarse in manner,
please forgive any rudeness, Yao.
我那不争气的儿子迷上了这紫衣女子的美貌，\n虽然紫衣女子对他不理不睬，他仍经常借:
My unpromising son was captivated by the beauty of this woman in purple,
although the woman in purple ignored him, he still often found excuses to pester him,
No matter how much I tried to persuade or scold him, he wouldn't listen.
我随即想到受伤的黑衣人可能在逃窜时一路留下血迹，\n壮起胆子想沿着血迹去瞧个究竟:
I immediately thought that the injured man in black might have left bloodstains along the way while fleeing,
Gathering his courage, he wanted to follow the trail of blood to see for himself, when suddenly a flash of lightning appeared in the sky,
then a heavy rain like beans poured down, washing away all the blood on the ground,
或许你与我一样，曾经与类似的处所有过什么缘分，\n我肯定从没来过这样的地方，如果:
Maybe, like me, you once had some kind of fate with similar partners,
I definitely have never been to a place like this, unless it weren't for the divine revelation of the Red Dragon,
perhaps it was what Granny Xulan said... Memories left behind from a previous life.
或许就是这段斩不断的因缘，\n你我今日才会再次在这个旧日之所相聚吧，\n而上天安:
Perhaps it is this unbreakable bond,
only today will you and I reunite in this old place,
and heaven arranged for me to be here only for one reason...
或许是有些自不量力，不过请容在下一言相劝，\n若阁下不肯住手停止作法，我们就只好:
Perhaps I overestimated myself, but please allow me to offer some advice,
if you refuse to stop and stop your practice, we will have no choice but to offend you.
房间正中的文字是「四」，算来是第六层没错，\n而从第一个房间中的「九」字来看，可:
The text in the center of the room reads '四', which is indeed the sixth floor,
Judging from the 'nine' character in the first room, it may have reached nine floors deep,
since we've already reached the sixth level, maybe we're not far from the finish line?
所以…我之所以想费这么大功夫救那姑娘，\n或许也是为了弥补几分当年的遗憾吧。:
So... The reason I went to such lengths to save that girl,
perhaps it was also to make up for some regrets from back then.
所以…我愿意相信自己真的是她失踪的儿子方中允，\n也决定留下来陪她一起过山村的平:
So... I am willing to believe that I really am her missing son, Fang Zhongyun,
he also decided to stay and accompany her through the peaceful life of the mountain village,
所以…或许你我彼此都不愿意与对方动手，\n但若你继续插手管这件事，我们迟早会再次:
So... Perhaps neither of us is willing to fight the other,
but if you continue to intervene in this matter, sooner or later we will draw our swords against each other again,
then I won't show you any mercy anymore... Can you understand?
所以上面特别交代属下，无须擒捕那些密探的首脑，\n只要确认情况并说服他们退走，让:
Therefore, the higher-ups specifically instructed subordinates not to arrest the leaders of those spies,
as long as we confirm the situation and persuade them to leave, making it seem like nothing has ever happened,
I know this is no easy task, so I ask the deputy commander and Young Hero Shen to be patient.
所以不论是你想从邹县回长兴村，或是想从这里回邹县，\n都可以顺便搭他的便车，于此:
So whether you want to return from Zouxian to Changxing Village, or from here to Zouxian,
you can also hitchhike along with him, so you really don't need to be so polite.
所以他名气虽大，却是神龙见首不见尾，\n真正看过他的人很少，我也是因为秦师伯才猜:
So although he was famous, he was like a dragon whose head was elusive,
Very few people have actually seen him; I only guessed it because of Master Qin,
it was truly strange that he suddenly appeared in a place like Hanyang today...
所以你是从小在与世隔绝的山谷中长大，\n而这被月光映成一片银白的景像…很像我生长:
So you grew up in a secluded valley, isolated from the world,
and this scene, illuminated by the moonlight, is a silvery white... It's very much like the place where I grew up,
it was the cold wasteland north of the Liao Kingdom, surrounded by ice and snow for years...
所以公子虽然与紫云崆峒两派掌门交好，\n但待会动手就是你死我活的厮杀，对方必定丝:
So although the young master is on good terms with the leaders of the Ziyun and Kongtong sects,
but when it came to a fight to the death, the other side would show no mercy,
we can't care about our friendship with the two sect leaders—we can only fight with all our might.
所以前辈早已知道到底是谁在背后指使萧姑娘，\n也料到霸剑将夺占义父心神，于是任由:
So the senior had long known who was behind the scenes directing Miss Xiao,
I also anticipated that the Overlord Sword would seize Foster Father's mind, so I let it achieve its goals,
then at The Ruins of Daliang, I watched as I fought Foster Father, and finally tried to seize it...
所以妾自从与公子同行以来，对许多事讳莫如深，\n就是深怕自己不慎失言，耽误了公子:
Therefore, ever since I traveled with you, sir, I have been deeply reserved about many matters,
he was deeply afraid that if he slipped up, he might delay the important mission he was carrying on this journey,
because of this, I have kept many secrets from you along the way. Please forgive me."
所以我自己从来就不想多看他一眼，\n但崆峒派世代与紫云派交好，看在师父的份上，\:
So I never wanted to look at him even once,
but the Kongtong Sect has been close to the Ziyun Sect for generations, and for the sake of the master,
when they met, she still had to be patient and treat him with courtesy...
所以我虽然十分遗憾，还是决定把你们丢在这里，\n之后我会记得帮你们在西湖畔的庙里:
So although I feel very regretful, I have decided to leave you all here,
Later, I will remember to set up a memorial tablet for you in the temple by West Lake,
please recite sutras every day, and help you be reborn in Pure Land. Farewell forever...
所以还请公子无需烦忧，即使上天会如何安排尚在未知，\n但只要咱们有所准备，必能顺:
So please don't worry, young master. Even if heaven's arrangements are still unknown,
but as long as we are prepared, we will surely overcome any difficulty and obstacle smoothly.
所以这绝谷里可做的事虽然不多，\n但有这些书可读，日子却也过得不无聊。:
So although there isn't much to do in this valley,
but with these books to read, life was never boring.
所以那个叫高奉的道士就找上夫人，\n说他可以救回薛大哥，对吧？:
So the Taoist named Gao Feng went to find the lady,
he said he could save Brother Xue, right?
所以那个带着云盘来典当，之后丢下它仓皇离开的人，\n应该就知道灵瑄妹子的三师兄在:
So the person who came to pawn the cloud drive and then left it behind in a panic,
he should know where Lingxuan's third senior brother is!
所谓慎小事微，看似不重要的事情往往关系重大，\n既然申兄弟觉得奇怪，咱们就去好好:
As the saying goes, 'be cautious of small matters, but observe small matters.' Seemingly unimportant matters are often of great importance,

With your assistance, Lord Lu has wiped out the long-standing Ghost Dragon Gang that has plagued Taihu,
if I ever encounter any difficulties in the future, I hope you will not be stingy to help.
申少侠，就当韦某求你们陪我活动活动筋骨吧，\n咱们定三场决胜负，若你们能接连打败:
Young Hero Shen, just consider it as my request for you to stretch your muscles with me,
we will settle three matches to decide the winner. If you can defeat two batches of Wei's soldiers in succession,
and in the final match, Wei himself conceded defeat and admitted defeat,
申少侠，很感激你帮我们找回小红，\n我们明白她是个特别的孩子，也会尽起养父母的责:
Young Master Shen, thank you very much for helping us find Xiaohong,
we understand she is a special child and will fulfill her responsibilities as adoptive parents,
I will definitely be especially careful in the future and never let this happen again.
申少侠，您的房间在敝店二楼，从楼梯上去便是，\n若您还需要些什么，请尽管吩咐。:
Young Master Shen, your room is on the second floor of our shop. Just go up the stairs,
if you need anything else, please feel free to ask.
申少侠，您的房间就在敝店二楼，\n从旁边的楼梯上去便是，请好好歇息。:
Young Master Shen, your room is on the second floor of our shop,
you can go up the stairs next to it, so please rest well.
申少侠，想必你接下来还有许多事要忙，\n我们已经在此打扰多时，点朱也吃了一肚子的:
Young Master Shen, I suppose you still have a lot to attend to,
we have been disturbing here for quite some time, and Dian Zhu has eaten a belly full of pastries,
I won't keep taking up your time,
申少侠，感谢你帮我们金华轩这个大忙，\n如果想坐下来喝茶吃块糕饼，郑嫂随时欢迎！:
Young Master Shen, thank you for helping us at Jinhua Pavilion with such a big favor,
if you want to sit down, have tea, or have a pastry, Mrs. Zheng is always welcome!
申少侠，我就知道你会帮三师妹解围，\n那么就有劳你替敝派接下这件事了，杨某十分感:
Young Master Shen, I knew you'd help Third Junior Sister out of trouble,
then I will trouble you to take on this matter on behalf of my faction. I am very grateful.
申少侠，我那三师妹是个性子比较特别的姑娘，\n虽然你和她相识的时日尚短，但你们两:
Young Master Shen, my third junior sister is a girl with a rather unique personality,
although you and she haven't known each other for long, you two seem to get along quite well.
申少侠，救回胡老板一事就全靠您啦，\n要是他有了什么万一，小的之后就不知怎么办…:
Young Hero Shen, rescuing Boss Hu is all up to you,
if anything happens to him, I won't know what to do next...
申少侠，时候似乎已经差不多了，\n准备好和我们一起赴宴了么？:
Young Master Shen, it seems the time has come for a while,
are you ready to join us for a feast?
申少侠，百里掌门这人或许看似风度翩翩、淡泊谦和，\n实则图谋深远、野心极大，若他:
Young Hero Shen, the leader of Baili, may seem elegant and modest,
In reality, your ambitions are far-reaching and your ambitions are immense. If he finds out about your relationship with Ba Jian,
they might do various things against you in order to seize the Overlord Sword,
申少侠，老夫可以明白你对申无名的父子之情，\n不过或许你们注定该缘尽于此，继续执:
Young Hero Shen, I understand your father-son affection for Shen Wuming,
but perhaps your fate is destined to end here; continuing to cling will bring no benefit,
Sigh, if anyone is to blame, maybe it can only be the 'Overlord Sword.'
申少侠，若你下次有机会遇到黄义，\n还请代替我向他问一声好。:
Young Master Shen, if you ever get the chance to meet Huang Yi next time,
please say hello to him on my behalf.
申少侠，虽然这玉简意外帮助我们逃离碧潮宫，\n但它之所以将我们带来「隐界」的一角:
Young Hero Shen, although this jade slip unexpectedly helped us escape Bichao Palace,
but the reason it brought us a corner of "the Hidden Realm" must have its purpose,
I believe you should be able to find the answer earlier.
申少侠，趁着现下有些闲暇，\n老夫想请你到房里单独聊一些私事，\n不知你方不方便:
Young Hero Shen, taking advantage of some free time now,
I would like to invite you to my room to discuss some private matters alone,
may I ask if you could have a word with me?"
申少侠，这里是三十颗霹雳子与一点小钱，\n就当成袁某不成意思的薄礼，请你务必收下:
Young Hero Shen, here are thirty thunderbolts and a small coin,
just consider it a small gift from me, Yuan. Please accept it.
申少侠，那位杨师兄已经先帮您付了房钱，\n您的房间就在敝店二楼，从旁边楼梯上去便:
Young Master Shen, that Senior Brother Yang has already paid for your room in advance,
Your room is on the second floor of our shop; just go up the stairs next door,
if you need anything else, please feel free to ask.
申施主，你的眼神似乎蒙上了一层阴霾，\n或许老衲不该向你提起此事…如果知道这些让:
Benefactor Shen, your eyes seem to be shrouded in a haze,
maybe I shouldn't have brought this up to you... If knowing these things makes you feel troubled,
just pretend I didn't say anything just now and leave everything to fate.
申施主，有件事老衲一直在考虑该不该说，\n不过上天安排这段因缘，或许就是为了让老:
Dear devotee, there's something I've been pondering about whether to say,
but perhaps Heaven arranged this fate so that I could explain this matter,
so I decided to take this opportunity to make things clear to you.
申无名一生追求剑的极致，为了证明自己的剑法天下最强，\n他一定会找天下武功最强的:
Shen Wuming spent his life pursuing the ultimate in swordsmanship, striving to prove that his swordsmanship was the strongest in the world,
he would definitely challenge the strongest martial artists in the world to a showdown,
申无名，好汉做事好汉当，\n你当年欠下的无数人命，要是装作忘记就能揭过，\n这笔:
Shen Wuming, a true man takes responsibility for his actions,
The countless lives you owed back then, if you pretend to forget, you can let it go,
but who will be the one to pay this blood debt?
白夫人，这件事在下刚刚在一旁大致听了分明，\n这胡天德分明是个乘人之危、想趁机鸠:
Lady Bai, I just overheard this matter from the side,
this Hu Tiande was clearly a dishonest merchant taking advantage of others' weaknesses, hoping to seize the opportunity to seize the magpie's nest,
since he used such tactics, we don't need to treat him with morality,
白姐姐猜得没错…我记不得是多久之前开始的，\n只要我一闭目躺下，脑里就会响起有人:
Sister Bai guessed right... I can't remember how long ago it started,
Whenever I lay down with my eyes closed, the voice of someone speaking would echo in my mind,
but the voice was indistinct and hard to discern, making it impossible to tell what was being said,
白姐姐，妳这一说正好提醒了我，\n我还记得邹县的李伯父，他过去和家父颇有交情，\:
Sister Bai, what you said just reminded me,
I still remember Uncle Li from Zou County; he used to have quite a close relationship with my father,
when I was staying at his place, he even said he wanted to take me as a disciple.
白姐姐，现在先别想那么多了，\n大家赶快爬到我背上来，此刻的紫煞封界非常不稳定，:
Sister Bai, don't overthink it for now,
Everyone, quickly climb onto my back. At this moment, The Sealed Realm is very unstable,
it could collapse at any moment. Let's leave here first.
白姐姐，真对不起，三师兄交代过我，\n在外不能随便说出自己的门派师承…:
Sister Bai, I'm really sorry. Third Senior Brother told me,
you can't casually reveal your sect or lineage outside...
白姑娘说得好，大哥你也不想想，\n你的性命可是申大哥他们冒险救回来的，\n然而咱:
Miss Bai said it well, big brother, have you thought about it,
Your life was saved by Brother Shen and the others at risk,
but our family is bare, how can we repay them?
白姑娘，你们崆峒派的人答应帮我找回夫君，\n可是都过好几天了，却一点消息都没有，:
Miss Bai, your Kongtong Sect people promised to help me find my husband,
but several days have passed and there's still no news at all,
白姑娘，我的夫君名叫许荐，是徐州有名的采药老手，\n平常他去附近的云龙山采药都只:
Miss Bai, my husband is named Xu Jian, a well-known veteran herbalist in Xuzhou,
Usually, he only needs a day or two to gather herbs at nearby Mount Yunlong,
but this time he hasn't returned for three or four days, so something must have happened.
白家妹子说得也没错，黄鹤楼之危既解，\n咱们在这汉阳城里一时也没什么急着要做的事:
The Bai family girl was right—once the crisis at Yellow Crane Tower was resolved,
we don't have anything urgent to do here in Hanyang right now,
Why not take advantage of this afternoon to take a walk around?
白家妹子，申少侠可是受了什么内伤，\n或是气血亏损，需要汤药调养么？:
Bai family girl, Young Hero Shen has suffered some kind of internal injury,
or is it qi and blood deficiency, and you need decoctions for recuperation?
白家妹子，这件事妳该早点让我知道，\n有位和我家老爷颇有渊源的名医就住在这附近的:
Bai family girl, you should have let me know about this sooner,
there is a famous doctor who has a close connection with my husband living nearby in Chishi Valley,
His medical skills were superb, but his personality was eccentric, and he never easily helped others with illnesses.
白师妹，看来当日我还真是不幸言中，\n没想到妳居然结交了这种邪魔外道，\n却不知:
Junior Sister Bai, it seems I was truly unlucky to be right that day,
I never expected you to associate with such evil and heretical cults,
but you don't know which side you plan to help when the time comes.
白老夫人，何大哥平时稳重得紧，绝非意气用事之人，\n想是他把夫人一家看得比谁都重:
Madam Bai, Brother He is usually very steady and composed, definitely not someone who acts on impulse,
it seems he regards the wife's family as more important than anyone else, which is why he is troubled by concern,
but since Madam has such a request, I will definitely keep a close eye on Brother He.
白霜瑶，老夫从小抚养妳长大，将妳当亲生女儿看待，\n没想到妳今日误交申子隽此等匪:
Bai Shuangyao, I raised you since you were little, treating you as my own daughter,
I never expected that today you would mistakenly associate with a criminal like Shen Zijun, not only protecting his collusion with the enemy,
he even openly spread rumors and slandered the elders of his own sect, acting recklessly and without forgiveness.
百里掌门师伯多年来闭门养伤，很少过问门内事务，\n这回他突然决定率本门参加武林大:
For years, Master Baili had been recuperating behind closed doors, rarely interfering in sect affairs,
this time, he suddenly decided to lead his sect to participate in the martial arts tournament, which surprised everyone.
百里掌门所言极是，不过诚如穆掌门刚才所言，\n我们可不能恃强相逼，把申少侠当成犯:
What the Baili Sect Leader said is absolutely right, but if it is truly as Master Mu just said,
we can't force Shen to be treated like a criminal during court trial,
he had to be willing to reveal everything himself.
百里掌门言重了，晚辈并无对前辈不敬之意，\n只是晚辈身为霸剑之主，需要它才能完成:
Sect Master Baili flatters me; I have no intention of disrespecting you,
but as the master of the Overlord Sword, I need it to fulfill the vital task of the survival of heaven and earth,
this is a matter of utmost importance. Please be sure to return the Overlord Sword here, senior."
百里掌门，别来无恙…晚辈一直有事想找您，\n自从之前在大梁城迹一别，晚辈就一直挂:
Sect Leader Baili, I hope you've been well... I have always wanted to see you,
since we parted at The Ruins of Daliang, I have been thinking about where you went,
Fortunately, my guess was correct—I guessed you had come to the Prayer Tower too,
百饕居这家饭馆不只是菜肴好吃，而且不挑客人，\n就算怀里掏不出几个铜钱，一样能在:
Baitaoju is not only delicious in its dishes, but also catering to guests,
even if you can't pull out a few copper coins from your pocket, you can still enjoy a delicious meal there,
Willing to spend money to taste truly good food, so it's often packed with guests.
的确，这一阵子以来我闯过不少古墓与秘道，\n却从没见过像这样的地方，还有这许多奇:
Indeed, over the past period, I have ventured into many ancient tombs and secret passages,
but I had never seen a place like this, and so many strange and incomprehensible characters,
it seems that, just as Miss Xiao said, this is an ancient maze hiding a great secret...
皇城司应该是开封城里最受人瞩目的官衙，\n他们不同于司掌刑讼之事的开封府，是直通:
The Imperial City Office is probably the most prominent government office in Kaifeng,
they were different from the Kaifeng Prefecture, which handled criminal cases; they were the eyes and ears of the emperor directly,
so when the Imperial City Division people showed up, everyone knew something big had happened.
皇城司的人行事诡秘，总是一脸高深莫测的表情，\n听说他们权责暗中查探开封城内高官:
The people of the Imperial City Division act secretively, always wearing expressions of profound mystery,
it was said that their authority was secretly investigating major illegal matters involving high-ranking officials and wealthy merchants within Kaifeng,
so the more powerful and influential someone is, the more wary and wary they are toward them.
皇城司直接受圣上之命，专门调查重大隐密之事，\n在这开封城内没有任何秘密能瞒得过:
The Imperial City Division was directly ordered by His Majesty to investigate major and confidential matters,
there are no secrets within Kaifeng that can be hidden from us.
皇宫内库无奇不有，我之前有过机会入内一窥，\n看到一些只曾在书上看过的珍奇药材，:
The palace's treasury is full of wonders. I once had the chance to enter and take a look,
Whenever I saw some rare herbs I'd only read about in books, I would casually grab a few,
as for where to find these herbs, I have no idea.
皇甫兄弟，灵瑄妹子，我们有个坏消息，\n我们进城时遇到了秦承纲秦师伯…以及左玄左:
Brother Huangfu, Sister Lingxuan, we have some bad news,
when we entered the city, we met Qin Chenggang, Master Qin... and Zuo Xuan, senior on the left,
although I don't know why they came to Hanyang, it's very likely they're here to see you...
皇甫兄弟，若左前辈再次传音询问，就麻烦你告诉他，\n我们会依照他的吩咐尽快赶去瘴:
Brother Huangfu, if Senior Zuo transmits his voice again to ask about it, please tell him,
we will follow his instructions and hurry to Zhangshen Valley as soon as possible,
Senior Zuo probably doesn't like to stay long; we need to set out quickly,
皇甫小兄弟，现在不是你逞强的时候，\n或许灵瑄妹子全心相信你，但是从你脸上的神色:
Brother Huangfu, now is not the time for you to show off,
maybe Lingxuan trusts you wholeheartedly, but from the look on your face,
I can see that at this moment, you really don't know where to go from here,
盗匪们躲进此地之后，还在墙面上四处挖凿隧道洞窟，\n成了更错综复杂的迷宫，这也是:
After hiding here, the bandits continued to dig tunnels and holes in the walls,
it has become an even more intricate maze, which is also the origin of the name 'Wuyou Cave'.
目前为止老夫只能先让它回复旧观，\n你想拿来挥舞一下无妨，但别忘记它仍未真正完成:
So far, I can only let it return to its old view,
if you want to wave it, that's fine, but don't forget it's not truly finished yet,
相信各派已有耳闻，有批辽人密探潜入宋土四处活动，\n领头的是一名叫做萧茵的奇特白:
I believe all factions have already heard that a group of Liao spies have infiltrated Song territory and operated everywhere,
Leading them was a peculiar white-haired woman named Xiao Yin. Although she was young,
but it's said that not only is her swordsmanship exceptional, she's also skilled in external spells and Taoist arts,
相信这本书必定能助我领悟冶兵的诀窍，\n让我打造一把好兵刃来作为给你的答谢。:
I believe this book will surely help me grasp the secrets of crafting weapons,
let me forge a fine weapon as a token of my gratitude.
看在这份难得的因缘上，我想让三师妹随你一起游历，\n虽然她江湖资历很浅，但她与你:
For the sake of this rare fate, I want Third Junior Sister to travel with you,
although she has little experience, she and you are kindred spirits and can look out for each other.
看来之前的乱界多半就是这人设下的，\n为的是不让人闯进东城之原打扰他所行之事，\:
It seems that most of the previous chaos in the realm was created by this person,
so that no one would break into the Dongcheng Plains and disturb what he was doing,
although he didn't know what his intentions were, he was definitely no ordinary person.
看来也只能如此了…只希望老天保佑小红，\n让我们有朝一日还能见到她…:
Looks like that's all we can do... I only hope heaven blesses Xiaohong,
so that one day we may see her again...
看来你已在赤龙帝君那里证刻了第一块玉简的铭文，\n说明你已经通过了他的考验，不过:
It seems you have already engraved the inscription on the first jade slip at Crimson Dragon Sovereign,
it means you have passed his test, but according to the rules,
you must personally test your skills to confirm that you truly can shoulder the great responsibility entrusted to the jade slips,
看来你还没想起来…不过这不要紧，\n今日会在这里遇到你，证明那小子说得的确没错，:
Looks like you still haven't remembered... But that's not a big deal,
Running into you here today proves that kid was right,
this time, I must not make the mistake of revealing the secrets of heaven again.
看来先前的地震让原本在这里的岩石松动掉落，\n露出了后面的洞口，我才得以从隧道回:
It seems that the previous earthquake had loosened and fallen the rocks that had originally been here,
only after revealing the entrance to the back was I able to return here through the tunnel.
看来前面没有路了，不过对面的距离似乎不算远，\n如果从这里凝神使劲往前一跳，或许:
It seems there's no path ahead, but the distance to the other side doesn't seem far,
if you focus and jump forward from here, maybe you can make it...
看来大师兄也对这次的事感到有点紧张，\n他似乎有些沉不住气，刚刚向掌门师父说去附:
It seems the eldest senior brother is also a bit nervous about this matter,
he seemed a bit impatient, having just told the sect leader to go nearby to check for any movement,
I guessed he was just out for some fresh air and should be back soon.
看来我注定与打造兵器无缘，我还是别想太多，\n专心当个打造农具的普通铁匠就好。:
It seems I am destined not to forge weapons, so I better not overthink it,
just focus on being an ordinary blacksmith crafting farm tools.
看来是之后的冲击把点朱和我们分开了，\n然后我们被送到了一个不知位在何方的处所，:
It seems that the subsequent impact separated Dian Zhu from us,
then we were sent to a place of unknown whereabouts,
Fortunately, it seems everyone just fainted...
看来是如此…绫素姑娘，此刻事出紧急，\n我们得马上带董兄回杭州城救治，否则就会太:
It seems so... Miss Ling Su, the situation is urgent right now,
we need to take Brother Dong back to Hangzhou for treatment immediately, or it will be too late,
let us explain all this to you later.
看来是说不通了…姑娘，我肯定不是他的对手，\n只能设法挡他一两招拖延时间，妳趁机:
It seems it just doesn't make sense... Miss, I definitely am no match for him,
you can only try to block one or two moves to buy time. Take this chance to escape!
看来此刻还是了尘居比较安全，\n至少夜魑应该不会开启入口的石门，\n咱们可以在那:
It seems that at this moment, Liao Chenju is still safer,
At least Nightfiend probably won't open the stone gate at the entrance,
we can wait there until dawn to find a way out.
看来确是如此…那黑雾最后在桥下钻进某处消失，\n那边有没有什么特别的处所？:
It seems that is indeed the case... The black mist finally disappears somewhere under the bridge,
is there anything special over there?
看来这就是小红经常无故离家的原因，\n不过我第一次看到这种东西，\n瑶妹，我们对:
It seems this is why Xiaohong often leaves home for no reason,
but this is the first time I've seen something like this,
Yao, can we handle it?
看来这差事可不好办…晚辈虽然知道玄铁和火铜，\n「遗火铸石」与「凝朔玄石」这两样:
Looks like this job isn't easy to handle... Although I know about black iron and fire copper,
The 'Emberfire Casting Stone' and 'Congealed-North Mystic Stone' are two things I've never heard of before,
could you please tell us where you can find these two items?
看詹掌事脸色如此凝重，\n却不知是发生了什么事？若詹掌事愿意见告，\n即使刚才有:
Seeing Steward Zhan's serious expression,
but what exactly happened? If Steward Zhan is willing to inform me,
even though there was some disagreement earlier, we were still happy to help.
真不可思议，听来是神明显灵向大叔托梦，\n不过他所说的持剑少年…莫非就是指我？让:
It's truly incredible. It sounds like a spirit is sending a dream to the uncle,
but the sword-wielding youth he mentioned... Could it be that he was referring to me? Let me think carefully,
Gray iron pieces and the Blood-Corrupted Spear—I think I've seen similar things before,
真是不可思议，找到第四块黑色石块之后，\n四块石头突然合而为一，成了方形的印记，:
It was truly unbelievable. After finding the fourth black stone,
The four stones suddenly merge into one, forming a square mark,
could this be the key to unlocking The Sealed Realm?
真是令人不敢相信，不一会儿的功夫，\n我们就从那梦一般的云上世界回到了尘世…:
It's hard to believe—in just a short while,
we returned from that dreamlike cloud world to the mortal world...
真是凶险…前辈会在这里被我们遇上，\n还在生死关头被瑶妹用本门灵药救回一命，\n:
It was truly dangerous... Seniors will be encountered here,
At the critical moment of life and death, Yao Mei saved his life with the sect's spiritual medicine,
it seems they are destined to be with us.
真是抱歉，我答应了帮大叔收集黑扁溪石，\n却连这点小事也没做好…:
